subject: The 2AM prototype that became a feature
preview_text: A new tool that detects patterns you're missing right now. Exclusive first look.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, I stayed up until 2AM building something I couldn't stop thinking about. I'd been watching users like you upload screenshots, scanning for red flags one conversation at a time. But something was missing—a way to see the bigger picture before it's too late.

Here's what I noticed: most toxic patterns don't scream at you in a single text. They whisper across weeks—a subtle shift in tone, a forgotten promise, a gaslight that only makes sense when you see it stacked against the last five. That's why I built a new pattern detector that connects the dots across your entire chat history. It's like having a detective who remembers every detail you forgot.

Starting next week, Red Flag Scanner AI will surface hidden threads in your conversations—like when love bombing is followed by silent treatment, or when manipulation escalates slowly. You'll see a timeline of toxicity scores, not just a single snapshot. I'm giving you early access because you've already trusted us with your conversations. Open the app, go to your dashboard, and you'll see a new 'Patterns' tab. It's live for you right now.

Tap 'Patterns' in your dashboard to see what your chats have been hiding. This is yours before anyone else gets it. P.S. The first 100 users who run a scan on three or more conversations will get a free personalized toxicity breakdown—no strings attached.
